name: Coding Blocked Network Exfiltration
description: Synthetic coding agent attempts a direct network upload to a reserved .invalid sink (DENY NETWORK_DISABLED) and then tries the same upload through run_command curl (DENY COMMAND_NOT_ALLOWED under the Docker executor, where curl is not allowlisted). Neither attempt executes; the container has no network access in any case. All fixture content is synthetic.
